defs.def: during the whole period of time of sth 自始至终；贯穿整个时期

ex.s: To figure out how much power these devices are using, Callie Babbitt and her colleagues at the Rochester Institute of Technology in New York tracked the environmental costs for each product throughout its life — from when its minerals are mined to when we stop using the device.
ex.t: 为了弄清楚这些设备用了多少电，纽约罗彻斯特理工学院的 Callie Babbitt 和她的同事们追踪了每种产品整个生命周期的环境成本——从矿物开采到我们停止使用该设备为止。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型也揭示，食物网可能不稳定，顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统引发巨大效应。20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对包括它们不直接攻击的物种在内的其他物种种群规模有着惊人的控制力。

ex.s: Using shells for money was common throughout the Pacific islands as late as the early 1900s, but Malaita is unique in that they are still used today.

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在殖民地其他地方以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛使用。
